result.instructions: Tools for updown.io, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes updown.io data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run updown_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run updown_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run updown_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. updown_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: updown_list_checks
tools.title: List checks
tools.description: List all monitoring checks on the account with their status (down, uptime, last_status, error), period, SSL certificate and domain-expiry info. Optionally filter client-side by status or a text match on URL/alias. updown: GET /api/checks.

status.description: Only checks in this state (default all).

search.description: Case-insensitive substring to match against the check URL or alias.

tools.name: updown_get_check
tools.title: Get one check
tools.description: Fetch a single check by token, optionally with the last hour of performance metrics and/or the detailed results of the last 5 requests. updown: GET /api/checks/:token.

token.description: The check's unique token, e.g. ngg8 (from updown_list_checks).

metrics.description: Include performance metrics for the last hour.

results.description: Include detailed results of the last 5 requests (can be large).

tools.name: updown_list_downtimes
tools.title: List a check's downtimes
tools.description: List the downtimes of one check, newest first, 100 per page: error, started_at, ended_at, duration (seconds) and a details URL. updown: GET /api/checks/:token/downtimes.

token.description: The check's unique token, e.g. ngg8 (from updown_list_checks).

page.description: Page to fetch (100 per page, default 1).

results.description: Include detailed results (last 5 requests before the downtime and recovery). Can be large.

tools.name: updown_get_check_metrics
tools.title: Get a check's metrics
tools.description: Get aggregated metrics for one check over a time range: uptime, apdex, timings (redirect/namelookup/connection/handshake/response/total, ms) and request counts by response time. Optionally group by 'time' or by 'host' (monitoring location). Data is hourly (daily after 2 days, monthly after 40 days); the range must span at least one hour. Uptime is not returned when grouping. updown: GET /api/checks/:token/metrics.

token.description: The check's unique token, e.g. ngg8 (from updown_list_checks).

from.description: Start time (ISO8601, RFC2822 or YYYY-MM-DD; UTC if no zone). Default: 1 month ago.

to.description: End time, same formats. Default: now.

tools.name: updown_find_problems
tools.title: Find checks with problems
tools.description: One-call health overview across every check: which are DOWN (since when, error), which have an invalid SSL certificate, which certificates or domains expire within N days, and which checks are paused or muted. Built from GET /api/checks.

ssl_days.description: Flag SSL certificates expiring within this many days (default 14).

domain_days.description: Flag domains expiring within this many days (default 30).

tools.name: updown_list_recipients
tools.title: List alert recipients
tools.description: List the alert recipients/channels on the account (email, sms, slack, telegram, webhook, zapier, ...). The `id` (e.g. email:3719031852) is what check `recipients` take. updown: GET /api/recipients.

tools.name: updown_list_status_pages
tools.title: List status pages
tools.description: List the account's status pages: token, public URL, name, description, visibility (public/protected/private) and the ordered check tokens shown. updown: GET /api/status_pages.

tools.name: updown_list_nodes
tools.title: List monitoring nodes
tools.description: List updown.io's monitoring/webhook servers keyed by location code (lan, mia, tor, rbx, fra, cap, hel, sin, tok, syd) with IPv4, IPv6, city, country and coordinates. Public — no API key needed. updown: GET /api/nodes.

tools.name: updown_list_node_ips
tools.title: List monitoring node IPs
tools.description: List updown.io's server IP addresses — e.g. to allowlist the monitors in a firewall. Choose all, ipv4 or ipv6. Public — no API key needed. updown: GET /api/nodes/ips, /api/nodes/ipv4, /api/nodes/ipv6.

tools.name: updown_create_check
tools.title: Create a check
tools.description: Add a new monitoring check. The type (http, https, tcp, tcps, icmp) is inferred from the URL scheme; pass type 'pulse' (and no URL) for a cron/heartbeat check. Each check consumes updown credits while enabled. Requires the read/write API key. updown: POST /api/checks.

url.description: The URL to monitor, e.g. https://example.com, tcp://host:port, icmp://host. Omit for pulse checks.

type.description: Check type; inferred from the URL by default — mainly useful for 'pulse'.

period.description: Interval in seconds. Regular checks: 15, 30, 60, 120, 300, 600, 1800 or 3600 (default 60). Pulse checks: anywhere from 15 s to 1 month.

enabled.description: Whether the check runs. false pauses it (reversible).

published.description: Whether the check's public status page is visible (default false).

string_match.description: Text that must appear in the response. For TCP/TCPS checks, '<closed>' inverts the check (alert if the port is open).

mute_until.description: Mute notifications until a time (ISO8601, e.g. 2026-10-01T08:00:00Z), or 'recovery', or 'forever'.

http_verb.description: HTTP verb for the request (default GET/HEAD).

http_body.description: HTTP body sent with the request.

disabled_locations.description: Monitoring locations to disable: lan, mia, tor, rbx, fra, cap, hel, sin, tok, syd.

recipients.description: Alert recipient ids to select, e.g. ['email:12345', 'sms:67890'] (from updown_list_recipients).

custom_headers.description: HTTP headers updown sends with each request, e.g. { "X-Api-Key": "..." }.

tools.name: updown_update_check
tools.title: Update a check
tools.description: Change a check's settings — URL, period, alias, string match, recipients, headers, locations — or pause/resume it (enabled) or mute its alerts (mute_until). Only the fields you pass are changed. Caution: URLs returned by a read-only key hide basic-auth credentials; re-sending such a URL erases them. Requires the read/write API key. updown: PUT /api/checks/:token.

token.description: The check's unique token, e.g. ngg8 (from updown_list_checks).

url.description: New URL to monitor (not for pulse checks).

period.description: Interval in seconds. Regular checks: 15, 30, 60, 120, 300, 600, 1800 or 3600 (default 60). Pulse checks: anywhere from 15 s to 1 month.

enabled.description: Whether the check runs. false pauses it (reversible).

published.description: Whether the check's public status page is visible (default false).

string_match.description: Text that must appear in the response. For TCP/TCPS checks, '<closed>' inverts the check (alert if the port is open).

mute_until.description: Mute notifications until a time (ISO8601, e.g. 2026-10-01T08:00:00Z), or 'recovery', or 'forever'.

http_verb.description: HTTP verb for the request (default GET/HEAD).

http_body.description: HTTP body sent with the request.

disabled_locations.description: Monitoring locations to disable: lan, mia, tor, rbx, fra, cap, hel, sin, tok, syd.

recipients.description: Alert recipient ids to select, e.g. ['email:12345', 'sms:67890'] (from updown_list_recipients).

custom_headers.description: HTTP headers updown sends with each request, e.g. { "X-Api-Key": "..." }.

tools.name: updown_add_recipient
tools.title: Add an alert recipient
tools.description: Add an alert recipient: an email address, phone number (sms), webhook URL, Slack-compatible incoming-webhook URL, or Microsoft Teams webhook URL. Returns the new (or already-existing) recipient with its id. By default it is selected on ALL existing checks; pass selected=false to add it unattached. Slack/Telegram/Zapier/Statuspage integrations must be set up in the web UI. Requires the read/write API key. updown: POST /api/recipients.

value.description: The email address, phone number or URL.

name.description: Optional friendly label (webhooks only at the moment).

selected.description: true (default) = selected on all existing checks; false = not selected on any check.

tools.name: updown_create_status_page
tools.title: Create a status page
tools.description: Create a status page showing the given checks, in order. Returns its token and URL. Requires the read/write API key. updown: POST /api/status_pages.

items.description: The check's unique token, e.g. ngg8 (from updown_list_checks).

checks.description: Check tokens to show, in display order, e.g. ['dmbe', 'ngg8'].

description.description: Text displayed below the name (supports newlines and links).

access_key.description: Access key for protected pages (defaults to a random 30-byte string).

tools.name: updown_update_status_page
tools.title: Update a status page
tools.description: Change a status page's checks (replaces the list, order respected), name, description, visibility or access key. Only the fields you pass are changed. Requires the read/write API key. updown: PUT /api/status_pages/:token.

token.description: The status page's unique token, e.g. 3ji4k (from updown_list_status_pages).

checks.description: New ordered list of check tokens to show (replaces the current list).

items.description: The check's unique token, e.g. ngg8 (from updown_list_checks).

description.description: Text displayed below the name (supports newlines and links).

access_key.description: Access key for protected pages (defaults to a random 30-byte string).
